propositions: Contract violation telemetry is recorded consistently in plan_review via a ContextVar sink but missing entirely from code_review pipeline, leaving code-review verdict coverage incomplete.

outcome_counts tally (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) is computed per-chunk inside verify_findings() loop but per-chunk boundaries are lost after workflow engine merges all chunks, making it unreconstructable at *_decide boundary without architectural change to verify step.

A shared contract-violation sink must be moved from plan_review/orchestrator.py into review_kernel and imported by both pipelines, with code_review activation in gate_dispatch._run_code_review_gate and drainage into finalize_code_review_verdict.

outcome_counts at the *_decide boundary can be derived as a whole-run tally from merged verifications and reshape state without per-chunk boundaries: empty_outcomes signals total verification failure, unrecoverable always 0 per workflow engine repair, recovered/clean depend on reshape.has_violations.

A shared review_kernel helper decide_outcome_counts() must compute and emit the single-run outcome_counts dict from both plan_review_decide and code_review_decide as additive coverage, with no changes to existing decision thresholds or verdict shape.
